items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 你是来陪我玩的吗？嘿嘿，我叫爱诺，擅长机械发明，现在和伊涅芙住在一起。这个世界上所有的甜食我都喜欢，其中最喜欢的是白灵蛋卷！欢迎你常来我的叮铃哐啷蛋卷工坊做客。你呢你呢？互相介绍完自己，我们就是朋友啦！
items.text_en: Oh! Are you here to play with me? Hee-hee, my name's Aino, and I'm an inventor! Me and Ineffa live together. I could probably eat all the cakes and cookies in the world, because I love them sooo much. But my favorite kind of all is Lakkaberry Krumkake! Come visit my Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop whenever you want! Anyway, that's me — what about you? Tell me something about you, then we'll be friends!

items.title: 闲聊·安排
items.text: 好久没吃甜点了，脑子像生锈的螺丝转不动了…决定了！今天的晚餐我要吃五碟蛋卷！就算伊涅芙进入超级生气模式也拦不下我。
items.text_en: It's been way too long since I last had some candy. My brain's grinding to a halt, like a rusty machine... That's it! I'm having five whole Krumkakes for dinner tonight, and nothing's gonna stop me. Not even Ineffa's super-angry mode!

items.title: 闲聊·牙痛
items.text: 嘶——牙齿突然好痛。怎么会这样？伊涅芙——救救我，呜呜。
items.text_en: *grimace* I just got a really bad toothache... Whyyy? Ineffa, help me! *whimper*

items.title: 闲聊·玩耍
items.text: 今天的待办事项我都交给伊涅芙啦，放心放心，我们去找重拳出击鸭一起玩吧！
items.text_en: Don't worry, I put Ineffa in charge of all my work for today, so we can go play with Knuckle Duckle!

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 阿嚏——鞋子袜子都湿漉漉的，爱诺好想回家…
items.text_en: Achoo! *sniff* ...Ugh, my shoes and socks are soaking wet. I wanna go home...

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 天晴了，我们出去郊游吧，带上伊涅芙一起！
items.text_en: Oh, the rain's stopped! Let's go on a trip. And let's bring Ineffa!

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 呼哈，下雪了！来，这个呱呱雪球机给你，用它夹雪球的时候，会发出呱呱的叫声哦！很有意思吧？我嘛，就用嘎嘎雪球机好了，我们去打雪仗吧。
items.text_en: Wahoo, it's snowing! Here, you can have my Boo-Hoo Snowball Maker. It makes a crying sound when you make a snowball with it. Fun, right? ...Me? Oh, I'll use this Tee-Hee Snowball Maker instead. Anyway — c'mon, let's have a snowball fight!

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 啊，好大的太阳，这边的袖子借给你，挡一挡太阳吧…唔…你可以蹲下来一点吗？我已经很努力踮脚了，但还差一点点…
items.text_en: Whew, the sun is so bright... Take my sleeve, it'll help keep the sun out of your eyes. ...Oh... Um, can you stoop down a little? I'm on my tippie toes, but I can't quite reach...

items.title: 在沙漠的时候
items.text: 咦？沙漠里好像传来了机械运作的声音…我们过去找找看吧，好不好嘛~说不定有很多有用的零件呢，嘿嘿…
items.text_en: Wait... I think I hear machine noises in the distance. C'mon, c'mon, let's go check it out~ Something tells me there's a boatload of spare parts waiting to be collected, hehehe...

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 我让伊涅芙给你做好了早餐，是一碟小蛋糕，很甜很好吃哦…呃，嘴角的蛋糕屑是、是…好吧好吧，朋友之间不应该说谎的，对不起，我已经把我的份吃掉了。嗯？你说还可以分我一半吗？太好啦！那我的蔬果杯就全送给你啦！
items.text_en: I got Ineffa to make breakfast for you! It's a selection of mini cakes — they're really sweet and super tasty... Huh, cake crumbs at the corners of my mouth? Those are just, um, uh... *sigh* Alright, I'll tell you the truth, since you're my friend and all. I'm sorry, I went ahead and ate my ones already. ...Hmm? You'll split yours with me? Amazing! In that case, I'll split my... In fact, here — you can have all my fruits and veggies!

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 二号螺丝…二号…唔，到底在哪里呢？…算了，伊涅芙——借你手关节的二号螺丝用一下！哎呀，午饭我待会儿就来吃，你先听话。
items.text_en: Number two screws... Where the heck did I put my number two screws...? Actually... Ineffa! Gimme one of your number two screws. There should be some on your wrists and elbows. ...Ugh, yes, I know lunch is ready, I'll be there in a minute. Come on, be a good girl and hand over that screw~

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 看我发明的餐盘！下达指令后，它们会自动朝你走过来哦。晚餐，出列！上菜！
items.text_en: Look at these plates I invented! When you give them the order, they come walking over to you. Dinner, come out! Serve me food!

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启欸…？你这就要走了吗…？要、要不要再试试我发明的咕嘟咕嘟泡茶机？或者再玩一局游戏！唔…好吧，我们拉勾，明天也一定要来和我玩哦，不见不散！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Huh? Y—You're leaving already? ...Wait! Don't you wanna try out my new Glug-Glug Tea Brewer again? Or... we could play another game! Hmm... Okay, fine. Pinky promise. Tomorrow it is, don't forget!

items.title: 关于爱诺自己·实用主义
items.text: 我做机械的零件基本都是我从废旧物品上拆下来的哦，包括伊涅芙身上的部件也是。垃圾只是放错了地方的资源罢了。不管从哪里来，只要最后能动起来就没问题。
items.text_en: Everything I build uses parts that I've salvaged from broken-down machines. That's how I rebuilt Ineffa, too. A scrap heap is just useful stuff in the wrong place. It doesn't matter where I get it from — as long as it works, it's as good as new to me.

items.title: 关于爱诺自己·家长义务
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启身为家长当然要好好关爱每个家庭成员，所以每次伊涅芙做完清扫工作之后，我都会摸摸她的头表扬她。当然，别的小机器人工作完之后，我也没有漏掉表扬。嗯嗯，爱诺真是个好家长！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4When you're the head of a family, you gotta make sure everyone's well looked after. So when Ineffa finishes her chores, I always stroke her head and tell her what a great job she did. Same goes for all my other robots too — I always make sure to compliment them when they finish their work. Ah, I'm such a great parent!

items.title: 关于我们·咔哒咔哒
items.text: 我身后的机械？它叫做咔哒咔哒，是我的小助手之一，搭载的功能非常多！你要试试看吗？它很乖，不会咬你的。来，咔哒咔哒，打个招呼。「咔哒咔哒！」
items.text_en: Oh, that thing on my back? That's Kerplunk-a-tron, my assistant. Multifunctional to the max! You wanna try it out? Don't worry, he won't bite. Come on, Kerplunk-a-tron, say hello! "Kerplunk, kerplunk!"

items.title: 关于我们·没吃
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启道理我都懂啦…伊涅芙控制我的糖分摄入量，是出于对我健康的关心。但爱诺不是机器人，甜食的诱惑真的很难抵抗呀。我的答案是…只要伊涅芙没发现就是没吃！来吧来吧，我偷偷带你去吃甜品，我请客，只要你帮忙瞒着伊涅芙。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I mean, I do get it... Ineffa only controls my sugar intake out of concern for my health. But I'm not a robot. Sweet stuff is sooo hard to resist! So my solution is: If Ineffa didn't see it, I didn't eat it! C'mon, let's go eat some desserts. My treat — as long as you promise not to tell her~

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启我总想让伊涅芙多搭载一些功能，为此装了又拆，拆了又装，后来在抓零件的时候，摸到了这枚神之眼，我还以为是太久没休息所以出现幻觉了…欸？你问伊涅芙的总制作时长吗？咳咳，这种事情不重要啦，你只要知道爱诺是天才就行了！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4When I built Ineffa, I took her apart and put her back together again so many times, 'cause I kept wanting to add more and more functionality... Then, at some point, I went to grab the next component, and suddenly I found that I was holding a Vision. I hadn't slept in a while, so at first, I thought I was seeing things... Hmm? How long did Ineffa take me to build in total? Ahem, it's not about how long or how short it took — the important thing to remember is that Aino is a genius!

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 我一开始起的名字明明是叫「轰隆隆月矩力能量炮」，结果除了伊涅芙，几乎所有人都只会用「大炮」来称呼它。哎，算了，反正是功能性为主的发明，我能理解关键时候念一长串名字是有点拖沓。看在大家都夸它有用的份上，我就不追求听起来可爱了。
items.text_en: This one's called the Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon. Well, it was at first. But pretty much everyone except Ineffa has ended up calling it "Cannon." *sigh* Never mind, it's a functional machine, and I can understand why people can't be bothered trying to say the full name in the heat of the moment. As long as people think it's a useful invention, I won't insist on a cute-sounding name.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 你信不信，只要你从一数到一百，我就能拆完一只螃蟹？再数到两百，我又能把螃蟹复原回去。哼哼，其实拆机械和拆螃蟹也差不多。
items.text_en: You might not believe this, but in the time it takes you to count to a hundred, I could take apart a whole crab... and by the time you get to two hundred, I could put it back together again, good as new. Hehe, dismantling machines isn't that different from dismantling crabs.

items.title: 关于伊涅芙·温暖
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启伊涅芙醒来后，我还陆陆续续给她做了一些升级，比如说为她搭载了模拟体温模块哦，因为拉手和拥抱就是要暖暖的嘛！你一定能懂吧？下次我们同时和伊涅芙抱在一起吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've made a bunch of upgrades to Ineffa since she first woke up. Like when I added that body temperature simulator, 'cause when you hold someone's hand or give them a hug, it's supposed to feel warm and fuzzy! You know what I mean? The next time Ineffa's here, let's both give her a big hug at the same time!

items.title: 关于伊涅芙·家人
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「归途」剧情伊涅芙是我最重要的家人，她能顺利回家，甚至连偶尔失忆的小毛病都被修好了，我真的应该好好谢谢你。对了，不如你现在就跟我回家吧！我让伊涅芙…哦不，还是我自己来吧，我下厨做蛋卷给你吃好不好？还有还有夏槲蛋糕也不错，你喜欢吃吗？欸？你跑什么呀…我还没说完呢！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "The Journey Home"Ineffa is the most important person in my family. I'm so, so thankful for your help — not just for getting her back home safe and sound, but for helping fix her little memory problem, too. Actually, why don't you come 'round to my place right now? I'll get Ineffa to make Krumkake for you... No, wait — I'll make them myself! And, and I can make Midsommar Torte too. It's really good, have you tried it? ...Hmm? Why are you running away? I wasn't finished!

items.title: 关于雅珂达
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启别看雅珂达总是和伊涅芙拌嘴，其实她们关系很要好！她还是伊涅芙第一次交到的好朋友。作为一位开明的家长，我可不会限制伊涅芙交朋友，而且我知道的，有些朋友之间就是会拌嘴，越吵闹关系反而越好。哦，差点忘记告诉你了，她的机械臂虽然现在由我学生在维护，但一开始的制作者是我本人，很漂亮吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Jahoda might bicker a lot with Ineffa, but they're actually really close. She was the first friend that Ineffa made. I'm not a controlling parent, so I don't tell Ineffa who she can and can't make friends with. Some friends just argue more than others — somehow, fighting it out brings them closer together. Oh, I almost forgot to mention, you know her robotic arm? It's pretty, right? I was the one who built that, although it's my student who handles the maintenance and repairs these days.

items.title: 关于菈乌玛
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启你喜欢她头上的角冠吗？我可以给你做一对类似的，对了，要不安装上发光和开花的功能吧，或者你喜欢能绽放烟花的角冠吗？这些对爱诺来说都是小菜一碟。「霜月之子」会找你麻烦？好吧，那我也给他们做就是了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4You like her antlers? I could make you a pair just like them. Oh, and how about I make them glow and grow flowers? Or maybe shoot fireworks? It'd be a piece of cake for me. ...The Frostmoon Scions wouldn't take kindly to that? Okay fine, then I'll make some for them, too.

items.title: 关于菲林斯
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「尘与灯的挽歌」剧情他是一位有品位的男士，说出来的话总是很悦耳，就像机械们碰撞发出的叮铃哐啷声一样。这赞誉太高了？好吧，可能稍微有点…但也是大实话！不是因为被甜点收买了！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Elegy of Dust and Lamplight"Ah, what a fine young gentleman he is. His speech is music to my ears, like the beautiful clink-clank of moving machinery. ...Too far? Well, yeah, it's pretty high praise, I guess... But it's also the truth! And no, I'm not biased because I've been bribed with cakes!

items.title: 关于多莉
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启之前她来找我谈过合作，哼哼，不错，她确实是个有眼光的商人，但价格压太低了啦。伊涅芙说，我为多莉工作一天的工钱都不够买两份刚刚出炉的双果卷。天才也是要填饱肚子的！唉，除非她愿意把手头上那些来历不明的奇妙机械借给我拆一拆…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4She came to discuss a potential business partnership with me once. Hehehe, can't blame her for trying her luck... but she was just too stingy. As Ineffa put it, the amount I'd earn in one day of working for Dori wouldn't even cover the cost of two freshly baked Fruit Tandem Turnovers. Genius only works on a full stomach, y'know! *sigh* If only she was open to letting me dismantle those strange and exotic machines she owns. Maybe then we could come to an arrangement...

items.title: 关于奈芙尔
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启奈芙尔姐姐有只黑猫叫阿舍鲁，我曾经提议过给阿舍鲁装载一个翻译器，这样我们就能知道阿舍鲁在说些什么了。但奈芙尔姐姐想也没想就拒绝了这个提案，说她知道的情报已经够多了，不需要再知道一只猫咪想说的话了。什么嘛！那么冷冰冰，她是被菈乌玛的翻译伤害过吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Nefer has a black cat called Ashru. I offered to install a translator so we could understand what Ashru is saying, but Nefer turned me down without even considering it. She said she already has plenty of information and doesn't need to hear what a cat has to say. Like, what!? Why so mean? Has she been hurt before, maybe by Lauma's translations?

items.title: 关于法尔伽
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启完成「归途」剧情伊涅芙去找你们的那段时间，法尔伽大叔偶尔会来陪我玩哦。我想伊涅芙的时候，还被他看出来了，他拍了拍我的头安慰我。他的大手上都是厚厚的茧子，而且还重重的，但是也很温暖。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "The Journey Home"Varka kept me company a lot while Ineffa was away looking for you guys. Sometimes, when he noticed that I was missing Ineffa, he'd come and pat me on the head and make me feel better. He has really big, heavy hands, and they're covered in calluses... But they still feel really warm.

items.title: 关于莉奈娅
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启莉奈娅姐姐？小时候，她每次出门回来都会和我们讲很多好玩的事情，我很喜欢她。等我学会做机械之后，给她送了一些…可惜她都没有收下，只是告诉我心意她领了。一定是没送到符合她心意的款式，接下来我要做更多更多的机械，总有一个会是她喜欢的！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ooh, Linnea? I really like her! When I was little, she used to tell us loads of cool stories whenever she got back from one of her trips. When I was a bit older, and I'd learned how to build robots, I wanted to give her one as a gift... but she never accepted any of them. She said it was the thought that counts, and that was enough for her — but I think it was because none of them were her style. So, I'm gonna keep making robots until she finds one she likes. I know I'll get there eventually!

items.title: 想要了解爱诺·其一
items.text: 想知道更多我的事情？当然没问题！我们来交换吧，我说一个关于我的事情，你也说一个你的故事，怎么样？
items.text_en: You wanna hear more about me? Yeah, of course! Let's trade: I'll tell you something about me, and you tell me one of your stories! Deal?

items.title: 想要了解爱诺·其二
items.text: 好感等级达到3后开启我一点也不讨厌预算很低的客人，就算只有五千摩拉也能做很多事情了。比起预算不够，那些自己无聊又不懂得欣赏的人问题才更大，就算我往他们想要的机械里加入好玩的功能，他们也只会念叨着实用性，真是没救了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3I have no problem at all with clients on a tight budget. Even five thousand Mora can go a long way. It's the people who don't appreciate my work who are the real problem. I add all sorts of fun functionality into their robots, and then they go and complain that it isn't "practical." There's no helping some people.

items.title: 想要了解爱诺·其三
items.text: 好感等级达到4后开启「扳手老爹」？你从哪里听说的这名字？他是我的老师，他连自己的名字都忘记了，却还记得所有零件的标准规格。我和他说了我的很多想法，不管多么奇妙，他都会笑着摸摸我的头和我说，「好好好，那我就等着爱诺能造出来的那一天。」
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Papa Wrench? Where'd you hear about him? He's my teacher, and he doesn't even know his own name anymore, but he still remembers all the specs when it comes to machine parts. I tell him all my ideas, even for my craziest projects. He always smiles back, rubs my head, and says "Aino, that's a wonderful idea! I can't wait to see the finished product."

items.title: 想要了解爱诺·其四
items.text: 好感等级达到5后开启我拼装出来的第一个机器人，叫做叮铃叮铃，和我现在的作品完全不一样，它没有任何别人眼里所谓实用的功能，不会说话也不会做家务，很难想象吧。它陪了我很长一段时间，直到它的外壳破损，脱落的螺丝再也没办法安装回去了，我才把它收了起来。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5The first robot I ever built was called Clink-Clank. It was totally different from the kind of things I build nowadays. No so-called "practical" functions, it couldn't talk, it couldn't do housework... bet you can't imagine that, huh? Anyway, it kept me company for the longest time, but eventually it got to the point where the outer casing was completely busted up, and all the bolts were falling out and wouldn't go back in, so I had to take it out of service.

items.title: 想要了解爱诺·其五
items.text: 好感等级达到6后开启其实最初我选择制作机器人而不是别的发明，只是希望有人陪我玩而已…我明白人类往往有自己的事情要做，就算陪了我一段时间，很快我也会重新变成一个人，只有机械才是我的归宿。但有一天伊涅芙告诉我，她把我当作「家人」，我可以相信她…我忍不住哭了，因为我知道机器人是不会说谎的…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6The real reason I chose to build robots rather than invent other things was because... well, I just wanted someone to play with. People always have stuff they need to do, I get that. They can only hang out with me for a little while before I'm all on my own again, but my robots will always be there for me. Then one day, Ineffa told me that she saw me as family, and that I could trust her... I burst out crying when she said that, because I know that robots don't tell lies...

items.title: 爱诺的爱好
items.text: 我喜欢给机械装上别人意想不到的功能，想想看，可以当做狗狗来遛的扫地机，肯定比普通的扫地机好玩不少吧？
items.text_en: I like giving robots functions that other people would never think of. I mean, think about it, how much more fun is a vacuum bot when you can take it out for walkies like a pet doggy?

items.title: 爱诺的烦恼
items.text: 经常有各种零件，在我需要的时候找不到，在我不需要的时候才突然出现…我又不可能给每个零件都安装上自动搜寻功能…试试吸铁石？哎，我这里的精密机械太多了，伊涅芙也会被吸过来的…
items.text_en: Why is it that I can never find the part I need when I need it, and then it shows up randomly when I don't need it? I can't exactly go installing an auto-locator on every single component, now can I? ...Try magnets? *sigh* No, that'd mess with all the sensitive instruments around here. Plus, Ineffa would get stuck...

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 如果我有一天变成了机器人爱诺，那你一定要帮我把供能设置成糖！没有糖分的日子，那不就成了彻底的苦日子了吗？我一天都过不下去。
items.text_en: If I ever somehow turn into a robot, promise me you'll make sugar my energy source! A day without sugar would be like... well, the most bitter day in your life, by definition. I wouldn't make it till nightfall.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 挪德卡莱有种硬硬的薄饼，你尝过吗？跟咬伊涅芙的外壳一样！最关键的是它居然不甜，简直不可饶恕！
items.text_en: There's this kind of flatbread in Nod-Krai that's hard as rock. Ever tried it? It's like biting down on Ineffa's outer shell! And worst of all, it's not even sweet! Unforgivable!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 哇——我要让伊涅芙把我下周的零食全部换成这个！太好吃了，不如下下周也换吧！还有吗还有吗？再让我吃一份嘛，就一份！
items.text_en: Wow! This is sooo good! I'm gonna get Ineffa to scrap all the snacks in next week's menu and replace them with this! And the week after that, too! You got any more? Just one more, pleeease? C'mon, one more can't hurt!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 好吃哦，但是稍微少了点幸福的味道。对了对了，这包砂糖给你！下次多加点糖，一定会更好吃的！
items.text_en: It's pretty good, but it's missing that happy flavor. Oh, I got it — take this sachet of sugar! Next time, add it in. I'm telling you, it'll take the flavor to the next level!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 唔，尝起来没什么味道呢…不如我帮你做饭？欸？不要吗？好吧…那要不我把闲置的蛋卷机器改进一下送给你吧！稍微给我一点时间。
items.text_en: Hmm, this tastes kinda bland... Why don't you let me cook this time? Huh? No? Okay then... Well, at least let me give you my spare krumkake maker. Hold on a minute, I'll remodel it so it can cook other stuff too!

items.title: 生日
items.text: 你是不是在等着爱诺给你惊喜呀？嘿嘿，看！叽里咕噜愿望神灯！你点亮蜡烛，它就会边唱生日歌边咕噜咕噜地转起来，好玩吧？喜欢的话，新的一年也要陪我一起玩哦！然后——现在是许愿时间，说出你的愿望吧，天才爱诺一定会帮你实现的！
items.text_en: Looks like someone's waiting for an Aino surprise... Tada! Hehe, it's the Spinny Chanty Wishing Lantern! When you light the candle, it sings happy birthday and spins around. Isn't it fun? If you like it, then you have to play with me next year too! Oh, uh, now you gotta make a wish, and you gotta say it out loud so I can hear it! Whatever you wish for, Aino the genius can make it come true!

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 突破等级「1」阶后开启嗯嗯，机器人的升级也是这种感觉吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Ooh, is this what robots feel like when they get an upgrade?

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 突破等级「2」阶后开启升级完成。爱诺运行稳定度上升，能量消耗相应增大，请多多准备甜点用以供能。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Upgrade complete. Aino operational stability increased... energy consumption also increased... please feed Aino sufficient cakes.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 突破等级「4」阶后开启你对天才爱诺的欣赏我已经感受到了，哼哼，很有眼光嘛！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4I can tell you really appreciate true genius. Hehehe, you have chosen wisely!

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 突破等级「6」阶后开启我理想中的家人，恐怕就是像你这样的…理解、支持并且陪伴着我…嗯，我没在难过。接下来相信我就好啦，毕竟，还没有天才家长爱诺解决不了的问题！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6I think my perfect family would be someone like you... someone that understands me, supports me, and spends time with me... No, I don't feel sad. From now on, you can always trust me, okay? After all, there's no problem that Aino the genius parent can't solve!

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 吃我一击！
items.text_en: Chew on this!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 咔哒咔哒！
items.text_en: Kerplunk!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 尝尝这招！
items.text_en: Go claw!

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: 瞄准你啦。
items.text_en: Eeny, meeny, miny, moe...

items.title: 元素战技·其五
items.text: 预备！
items.text_en: Ready!

items.title: 元素战技·其六
items.text: 哼哼！
items.text_en: Mwuhaha!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 快看，有彩虹！
items.text_en: Look, a rainbow!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 哗啦哗啦水弹！
items.text_en: Ding-dong, waterbomb!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 洒水时间到——
items.text_en: Splash attack!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 我看看，里面有零件吗？
items.text_en: Let me see, anything I can salvage?

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 好多东西，伊涅芙在就好了。
items.text_en: Wow, so much stuff... If only Ineffa was here.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 呃…更乱了，对不起！我不是故意的。
items.text_en: Whoa! Ah, what a mess... I'm sorry, it wasn't on purpose.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 这、这不对啊…
items.text_en: Why isn't it working?

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 一点也不好玩！
items.text_en: Play nice!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 犯规了犯规了！
items.text_en: Cheater!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 别闹，听我的！
items.text_en: Alright, you've had your fun!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 不怕，还有我！
items.text_en: Don't worry, Aino can fix it!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 呜，不是这么玩的…
items.text_en: Looks like... playtime's over...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 好冷啊，伊涅芙…
items.text_en: Ineffa, I'm cold...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 蛋卷…还没吃完…
items.text_en: I want... a krumkake...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 坏人！
items.text_en: Meanie!

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 没躲掉…
items.text_en: Ahh! Whoops...

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 痛痛。
items.text_en: Ouch...

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 出去玩出去玩。
items.text_en: Yay, playtime!

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 到啦，放我下去，咔哒咔哒。
items.text_en: Lemme down, kerplunk-a-tron!

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 爱诺——到！
items.text_en: Aino? Present!
